2014_spells.scatter.effectSummary: Teleport up to 30 ft to a space you can see
2014_spells.scatter.fullDescription: Using 1 action, the destination you choose must be on the ground or on a floor, and it must be unoccupied. You teleport each affected target to an unoccupied space that you can see within 120 feet of you; An unwilling creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC to resist this effect. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
